articleTitle: Drones Based on Multi-detection and Mobilize Algorithm for Observation and Routing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This study aims to address the observation and routing issues associated with drones by developing an algorithm based on cooperative placement and multi-detection. The algorithm uses collaborative positioning technology to provide high-precision drone positioning while also enabling observation of the nearby s with multi-detection technology. Based on this, a state-space model is employed to optimize the fused data, increasing the precision of the routing and observation outcomes. The investigational test was conducted for UAVs to validate the algorithm suggested in the paper. The outcome demonstrate that the observation and routing algorithm developed in this study which effectively improve positioning accuracy and communication efficiency, increase observation accuracy to a maximum of 96.8%, and decrease collision accidents brought on by vehicles inadvertently entering obstacle areas.

articleTitle: Advancing Mobility Enhanced Edge Intelligence for 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Edge intelligence emerges as a novel paradigm facilitating real-time training and inference at the wireless edge, empowering critical applications. This necessitates the dense deployment of base stations (BSs) and edge servers (ESs), leading to significant deployment and operational expenses, particularly in energy consumption. Presenting a groundbreaking framework, Mobility-Enhanced Edge Intelligence (MEET), leverages the sensing, communication, computing, and self-powering capabilities of intelligent connected vehicles to optimize 6G networks for intelligence and sustainability. Operators can integrate infrastructural vehicles as mobile BSs or ESs, strategically scheduling them to align with communication and computation traffic fluctuations. Additionally, idle compute resources of opportunistic vehicles are harnessed for edge training and inference, utilizing mobility to augment edge intelligence through increased compute resources, communication opportunities, and diverse data. This innovative approach efficiently distributes deployment and operational costs across a multitude of vehicles, ensuring cost-effective and sustainable realization of edge intelligence. Moreover, these vehicles can be powered by renewable energy, mitigating carbon emissions, or charged during off-peak hours for flexibility in electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-Functional IoT Robot: Exploring the Evaluation of Robot Operations in Military Applications Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Robotics is the most fascinating and rapidly expanding field of study in the modern period. A robot's ability to sense its surroundings and respond correctly depends on the variety of inputs and outcomes it possesses. Scientists have developed military robots through technological research and development. The outcome was a battlefield where troops' lives were less threatened. Military robots are employed for a variety of dangerous jobs, including monitoring battlegrounds, reducing live bomb explosives, detecting bombs, and shooting at attackers. The detectors, handles, arms, cameras, and motors found on these military robots are all part of an integrated system. A robot may alter its form and personality to suit its job. Robots with complete autonomy are in high demand due to the populace and army's struggles with terrorism and revolution. Countries spend a lot of money trying to find ways to protect their populations against terrorist attacks. In this paper, a novel approach is presented, the Multi-Functional IoT Robot (MFIoTR), which aims to offer users superior robotic assistance. To test the efficacy of this approach, the proposed robot is cross-validated with the more traditional Classical Surveillance Robot (CSR). An autonomous robotic arm is crucial to this system. Every action is monitored by a micro controller. The ROBOT's direction of travel is determined by its motor activity. Using Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the user may interact with this robot. A person can be located using the robot's ultrasonic sensor. Along with other sensors, the military uses the proximity sensor to find land mines. Whenever a sensor detects an activity, the robot stops and sounds an alarm.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimal Offloading Approach in Fog Computing using PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The efficiency and energy of fog computing systems are balanced via task scheduling. the scheduling of jobs using dynamic scheduling methods in response to user demand. Swarm intelligence has recently been proposed, and it is based on multiple work scheduling methods. The scheduling and rescheduling of task policy is the main challenge of controlling edge devices in fog computing environments. The dynamic task scheduling technique suggested for fog computing is the main topic of this paper. The suggested work scheduling algorithm combines ant colony with particle swarm optimisation. The suggested technique focuses on minimising the processing time of data and requests for fog computing. The hybrid algorithm handles virtual machines as local or global according to task policy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Convolute Neural Approach in The Prediction of RNA Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of RFID-Driven Parking Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The present research study provides a comprehensive analysis of a design study aimed at addressing the obstacles encountered in RFID technology implementation for car park systems. By employing RFID tags as a central component and complemented by dedicated software, the system effectively manages various operational aspects, including control, sales reporting, and overall car park management. The integration of RFID technology facilitates automated, secure, and unattended parking processes, thereby mitigating congestion and reducing air pollution. Particularly in urban areas where parking issues contribute to commercial traffic and public frustration, the system utilizes advanced monitoring techniques to direct vehicles to available parking spaces. Furthermore, it incorporates a reservation-based strategy to optimize traffic flow management. The design approach prioritizes simplicity, cost-effectiveness, and the utilization of RFID technology to develop a pragmatic solution for urban parking challenges.

Author Keywords: RF ID sensing module,ESP32 node MCU

articleTitle: Design and Application Analysis of Multi-Station Fusion Visualization System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of existing substation visualization systems, a multi-station integration visualization system based on digital twin technology is proposed on the basis of substation space scene construction. By analyzing the application of digital twin technology in electric power industry, a design scheme of multi-station fusion visualization system based on digital twin technology is proposed. Virtual reality and artificial intelligence technology are used to monitor different substations to realize real-time interaction between physical entities and virtual world information. By analyzing the demand and development trend of electric power industry, a multi-station integrated visualization system is designed. The system can realize unified management and monitoring of multiple substations in the power industry, effectively reduce labor costs, and improve the informatization level of the power industry. Through the research, it is found that the digital twin technology has high application value in the field of substation technology development, which can break through the traditional technical barriers and achieve a high level of visualization, so it is worth promoting.

articleTitle: Tomato Plant Disease Detection Using Image Processing for Agriculture Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This research paper outlines a new method for detecting diseases in tomato plants using advanced image processing techniques. The proposed approach involves several steps, including capturing high-quality digital images of tomato plants with a camera and processing the images to improve their visual features. Once the diseased regions have been identified, a set of features are extracted from them using texture analysis and color- based features. These features provide a unique signature that can be used to distinguish between different types of diseases, such as early blight, late blight, and bacterial spot, with high accuracy. The proposed method was evaluated using a large dataset of tomato plant images with different types of diseases, and the results demonstrate that it can accurately identify and classify the diseases with high precision. By enabling early detection and identification of plant diseases, this method can help farmers prevent crop losses, reduce the use of harmful pesticides, and promote sustainable agriculture practices.

articleTitle: An Innovative Animal Care and Management System Integrating Internet of Things (IoT) Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The Intelligent Animal Care and Management System Based on the Internet of Things is a comprehensive solution for monitoring and managing animals in a zoo environment. The system uses a range of sensors and an Arduino board to collect and analyze data on environmental conditions, animal behavior, and vital signs. The system includes automated mechanisms for cleaning and feeding animals, providing a safer and more consistent environment for animal care. The proposed system aims to improve the welfare of animals in zoos by providing continuous monitoring of their environment and health, and by automating some of the caretaking tasks. The system has the potential to revolutionize animal care and management in zoos, with implications for animal conservation and education.

articleTitle: Linking Robots to Human Thought: Bridging Minds and Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This extensive report provides a comprehensive overview of Artificial Intelligence (AI), including its history, definitions, classification, philosophy, applications, and benefits and drawbacks. It begins by tracing the development of AI from its inception to the present, highlighting significant milestones and obstacles. The document also examines AI’s mythological antecedents. The document classifies AI into four categories, ranging from reactive machines to self-aware systems, and provides an overview of its present capabilities and potential future developments. It focuses on the operations of artificial intelligence in robotization, machine literacy, machine vision, natural language processing, robotics, and independent vehicles. An assessment of AI’s development since 2010 is presented, highlighting significant developments and ethical considerations. The document outlines and emphasizes the impact of 18 critical AI applications across a variety of industries. The document concludes with a discussion of AI’s benefits, including error reduction, safety enhancement, and innovation, while acknowledging concerns such as employment displacement and privacy concerns and emphasizing the need for ethical guidelines. This document provides an exhaustive overview of AI’s history, applications, and societal implications, as well as its advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Techniques for Gait Recognition: An In-Depth Exploration of Biometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This investigation pioneers a thorough exploration into the domain of gait recognition within biometric analysis, specifically addressing the challenges unique to gait as a biometric identifier. The study systematically analyzes an array of machine learning (ML) algorithms, encompassing methodologies such as Individual Node Evaluation, Statistical Inference, Regression Modeling, Supportive Vectorization Technique, Nearest Neighbor Classification, Decisional Tree Structure, Randomized Forest Ensemble, and Multilayered Node Connection. Rigorous testing is employed to evaluate the efficacy of each model in accurately identifying individuals based on their distinct gait patterns. The methodology prioritizes detailed preprocessing to ensure data integrity and relevance. Furthermore, the exploration involves employing Sequential Backward Selection (SBS) for feature selection and implementing dimensionality reduction techniques like Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). This enhances the effectiveness of the model by concentrating on the most relevant features.The research further explores deep learning models, assessing various architectures to understand their impact on gait recognition accuracy. A meticulous comparative analysis highlights the strengths and limitations of each approach, offering unique insights to the field. By evaluating a range of ML and DL techniques, this study establishes a benchmark for future advancements in biometric security. It underscores the potential of gait recognition as a reliable, non-invasive identification method, laying the groundwork for the development of advanced and accurate biometric systems essential in the dynamic landscape of security and personal identification.

articleTitle: Survey on Health Care Monitoring of Paralyzed People
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Health monitoring is one of the industries that is now on the rise and making quick strides in its development. According to the technological developments in healthcare systems, several analysts have suggested various arrangements for monitoring the health of paralyzed persons. The Internet is widely used nowadays, and one recent area that has seen growth is the Internet of Things (IoT), which many people have chosen to incorporate into a variety of applications. IoT is commonly utilized to link many easily accessible medical and related device resources. For individuals who are paralyzed, it offers amazing, efficient, and productive medical treatments. The secret to assist and dynamic living—which actively helps and modifies the paralyzed person by keeping an eye on his health—is to continuously improve the quality of life for those who are paralyzed. We provide a quick summary of the most current findings and advancements in the field of health monitoring systems for paralyzed people.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines Application for Prediction Binding Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: During the human thread age, classifying genetic functionality remained among one of both greatest essential as well as difficult challenges. Non-sequence attributes from particular proteins, on the same hand, might prove indicative of biological action. articleTitle: Emerging Cybersecurity and Efficiency: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Avoiding Deduplication on Secure Remote Data Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The protection of sensitive information is paramount in today's rapidly developing digital landscape. In recent years, cloud computing has grown in popularity as an efficient means by which government agencies may handle their data. Approximately bytes of information are created daily on the internet. In order to store this massive quantity of data, we want servers that can efficiently deduplicate data to prevent storage wastage and keep expenditures down. On top of that, data security is essential because cloud storage is offered by third party providers. Security procedures are incompatible with data deduplication techniques. In this research, we will examine different approaches to do this deduplication. The findings demonstrate that duplicate data is consistently associated with the same hash code, which prevents it from being uploaded to the cloud servers and guarantees effective deduplication. Because it gets rid of redundant data, it saves space and bandwidth. A lot of work has gone into making sure that everyone involved in this project has full access to the data kept on the drive cloud server. Because protecting sensitive information is paramount when using efficient deduplication, all data saved in the cloud is protected at all times. These all are accomplished by means of a proposed cryptographic logic called Advanced Cyber Crypto Norms (ACCN), in which it is cross-validated with the conventional cryptographic algorithm called Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review using Blockchain Technology for IOT-Based Health Care Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Today, Internet of Things (IoT) data sharing is a big challenge for increasing the progress, efficiency, and effectiveness of any organization in the health sector through IoT-based applications. Generally, health records follow centralized abilities in the IoT. Health sector Data Security and failures of centralized servers are issues in the IoT. Peer-to-peer networks utilize distributed applications and duplicate transactions leveraging digital ledgers in the blockchain. Blochchain is recording all health information on a decentralized system that is impossible to change or hack. Blockchain technology supports IoT privacy, cryptocurrencies, healthcare, smart contracts, supply chain management, identity verification, insurance, etc. IoT-based health records contain a lot of problems like privacy, security, performance, ethics, data ownership, patient access and control, etc. In easy ways, blockchain technology exacerbates these kinds of problems. Ethereum and Hyperledger are supported as frameworks using blockchain technology. Compared to the previously specified data values, IoT-based health data has a significantly higher level of security and privacy. This study explores in detail the various approaches, workings, and technical details used in various languages.

articleTitle: Music Generation Algorithms: An In-Depth Review of Future Directions and Applications Explored
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Music generation algorithms have made significant progress in recent years, enabling the development of algorithms to generate creative and realistic music. This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of music generation algorithms organized by algorithm type. We discuss each algorithm type's strengths, weaknesses, and applications. We also cover multi-level representations for music generation, which allow algorithms to learn complex patterns in music data at different levels of granularity. This survey paper is intended to be a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners in music generation. It provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art in music generation algorithms and highlights this research area's challenges and future directions.

articleTitle: Research on Data Leakage Detection and Protection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data on the Internet, people provide more personal information to enterprises for management through software media, which leads to a series of privacy data leakage and security problems. In this paper, deep learning algorithm is used to conduct Private Data Leak Analysis (PDLA). In this paper, the risk of privacy data leakage is quantitatively evaluated, and the accuracy and recall rate of personal privacy information data leakage are evaluated. Comparing the data leakage detection system with the traditional vulnerability scanning tool Find Security Bugs, the recall rate of this system is 95.04%, and that of Find Security Bugs is 82.64%.

articleTitle: Optimize Analysis of Combined R2B, R4B and R8B FFT using Single Path Delay Feedback
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: FT is generally employed to convert the examined signal to frequency domain. FFT is a proficient method to configure discrete DFT. It is a significant method in DSP field that is used for configuring the DFT proficiently. FFT is just a computational algorithm and not another transform. This DFT modification lessens the calculation time. It firmly limits the execution cost on digital computing systems. In FFT the calculation performances has been improved by applying a divide and conquer approach. This methodology depends on decomposition and it breaks the transform as smaller transforms and the final consolidation leads to derive the complete transform. In FFT, the majority calculations can be dispensed by utilizing the symmetry and the periodicity classifications of the fidget factor. The prime merit of FFT is to decrease the number of computations. In this paper, design FFT 16-point FFT using combine R2B, R4B & R8B and SPDF. The design is implemented Xilinx 14.5i and calculate slice, LUT and delay.

articleTitle: RansomSheild: Novel Framework for Effective Data Recovery in Ransomware Recovery Process
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Ransomware attacks are very common nowadays and they are meant to disrupt normal operations and businesses which has ultimately led to data stealing and theft. These types of attacks can become a concern for brand image and information loss. This research paper critically analyzes the existing data recovery methodologies employed in industries for recovery from ransomware attacks. Furthermore, a novel framework is proposed to shield the critical information stored in data servers by utilizing network segmentation, a honeypot device for collecting logs and machine learning-trained devices. The proposed network architecture is effective in the early detection of ransomware attacks and taking action against these attacks without manual procedures. The proposed framework is employed for ransomware attack datasets and machine learning algorithms are compared for detection of attack using behavioral analysis of network traffic. The performance evaluation of deployed machine learning algorithms is presented based on metric accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. The results prove that XGBoost technique is outperforming the deployed machine learning algorithms for early detection ransomware attack.

articleTitle: Prediction and Recognition of Drone Magnetometer System using Artificial Intelligence with Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The evolution of advanced technology plays a vital role in diverse arena. This helps in the introduction of drone magnetometer system. The drone is an electronic system with sensors to monitor and detect the targeted system thus they are created to visualize the near environmental surfaces and objects. This is accomplished through the magnetometers, radar, GPS and various sensors. These technologies are integrated with IoT, artificial intelligence techniques and edge computing techniques. The numerous data are processed through the image processing and recognition techniques. The security and privacy are enhanced to adopt a safer operation in various sectors. The important challenges include the monitoring of the transmission lines in which heavier electromagnetic waves occur. To avoid these consequences, the drones are manufactured and adopted with advanced technologies. The drones are integrated with the internet of drones to provide various navigation services accompanied with the internet of things. Thus the overall process is implemented through artificial intelligence through deep learning and k-means algorithm and edge computing techniques.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression based Sentiment Analysis System: Rectify
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The detection of various reactions using computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence is a rapidly growing field of research. In this paper, we present a sentiment analysis model based on the Python, NLTK (natural language toolkit) libraries, and machine learning algorithms that can detect multiple reactions from the public on a single platform. The proposed Sentiment Analysis System deals with the very usual problem faced by different companies, manufacturers, and sellers about knowing the customer review for their product. The model classifies the public reviews and the normal text as positive, negative, or neutral. This proposed system is categorised into two parts, one being a field-specific sentiment analysis and the other being a generalised system that can judge any particular word or sentence to be either positive, negative, or neutral. The proposed model is also capable of representing a huge dataset (input as a csv file) in the form of a graph, which can be easily understood by the desired person, and the graphical representation is possible with the Matplotlib library of Python. The model's performance is evaluated using several metrics, such as precision, recall, and others. The model's accuracy and efficiency make it a promising tool for sentiment analysis, which can be used by anyone in any field. In conclusion, the system can work for any specific field provided the data set, and the generalized way can help out with random sentences, and the model’s potential can be boosted with some further research.

articleTitle: Harnessing Biomedical Signals: Hadoop Infrastructure, AI, and Fuzzy Logic in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The use of biological signals has increased dramatically in a number of developing countries, which has led to a growing interest in its integration into healthcare management systems. On the other hand, providing strong assistance for signal transmission across a communication medium is limited by the present infrastructure. Biomedical signals are complex and must be categorized at different phases in order to be sent effectively. In order to overcome these obstacles, this paper presents a new strategy that makes use of Hadoop-based systems with a four-layer paradigm. This model uses reference health data from various treatment facilities to simplify data transmission between layers when combined with the Flexible Interface Software Algorithm (FISA), which is known for having poor resilience. With this new approach, we want to improve performance by reducing the functionality losses that come with biological signals. In order to further improve signal strength, geographical separation, and cost, an activation function is included at intermediate stages. The effectiveness of the suggested approach is assessed by simulated using MATLAB and a toolkit for biomedical signal processing.

articleTitle: Transforming Shopping with IoT: Exploring the Intelligent Way to Design the Smart Trolley using IoT Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The interconnection of commonplace items is revolutionizing people's daily lives, thanks to the Internet of Things (IoT). A smart shopping system, consisting of interconnected products, might one day be a reality in supermarkets. In this Internet of Things system, products may be individually identified using low-cost RFID tags, which, when added to an RFID-enabled smart shopping cart, can be read automatically. This means shoppers won't have to endure the checkout line at all—billing can be handled right in the cart. The integration of RFID-equipped smart shelving into this system allows for the monitoring of inventory and, perhaps, the update of a central server. The suggested shopping system, which is dubbed IoT Assisted Smart Trolley (IoTAST), is cross-validated with the standard Smart Trolley (ST) model to clearly evaluate its performance. Since an RFID reader can automatically read all objects instead of a labourer physically scanning them, inventory management becomes considerably easier with this sort of technology. We construct a working system to test its functioning, determine the design criteria of a sophisticated purchasing system, and then create a reliable communication mechanism that renders the system feasible. This study validates the viability of the system. This is the first smart shopping system that takes security into account that we are aware of.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Detection of DDoS Attacks in IoT Using Federated Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Internet of Things devices are widely employed in various industries, cities, and institutions as with low-cost investment various benefits can be obtained. The computing power, bandwidth, memory storage and battery are low in these devices and lightweight routing protocols are used for communication. Distributed Denial Service of Attack takes benefit of Internet of Things architecture and targets vulnerable devices to take control of the device. These hacked devices can be further used by attackers to send massive data packets to the victim's device. Generally, data servers and high computing devices are targeted by attackers through Internet of Things devices. Artificial intelligence-based cybersecurity is extensively employed in various scenarios but as there is a constraint of resources in the Internet of Things, the same approach is not feasible. Further, artificial intelligence-based solutions are required to deal with network traffic-related data, and organisations are reluctant to share the data. This research work targets to provide a solution for the early detection of distributed denial of service attacks using a federated learning model by preserving the information of the users. The client and server in the proposed approach are trained using Identically and Non-identically distributed approaches. The performance evaluation of both approaches is performed using metrics like accuracy, loss, precision and recall for the detection of cyberattack by model aggregation.

articleTitle: Generalized Deep Neural Network Classifier for Non-Code RNA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The longest non-coding RNAs have been extensively explored as well as published in current history for their participation in transcriptional copying, immunological reaction, developmentally induced pluripotent stem cells, tumorogenesis, including hereditary control, among other cellular activities. Many theoretical and simulation techniques for genome-wide searches as well as showings of ncRNAs have been developed, each with its own set of constraints, based on sequence properties such as size, frequency, as well as a backbone structure. In comparison to other classification methods, the suggested Deep Neural Network (DNN) seems to be a rapid and precise substitute for identifying lncRNAs. Utilizing annotated image learning algorithm from LNCipedia as well as RefSeq file, the data preserved ink-mere patterns would be used as an exclusive characteristic for the DNN classification model, yielding a precision of 98.07 percent, responsiveness of 98.98 percent, as well a clarity of 97.19 percent, including both, on the validation set. The enhanced classification performance was due to the k-mere data benefits created using the Shannon entropy algorithm. Such implementation of an appropriate has also been evaluated on a published human DNA collection, and it is 99 percent accurate in identifying recognized lncRNAs.

articleTitle: AI-Based Bolt Loosening Diagnosis with Deep Learning from Laser Ultrasonic Wave Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Deep learning (DL) algorithms for non-destructive evaluation (NDE) are becoming more popular, especially for the use of laser ultrasonic methods to identify and estimate looseness in bolted joints. By examining the connection between the energy lost by the passage of ultrasound waves and the bolt head-plate's genuine contact area, this work advances the field. The study used ultrasonic wave travel imaging to produce a 3D full-field sonar dataset utilizing an acoustic emission camera and a Q-switched Nd: YAG pulsating laser. The research also highlighted how crucial signal processing methods are to improving DL performance for automated looseness estimate.

articleTitle: Development of Vital Sign Monitoring System for Military Soldiers Using Wearable Antenna Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: In the contemporary landscape, an array of technologies has emerged for the measurement and monitoring of vital signs in humans, encompassing crucial parameters like heartbeat, temperature, respiration rate, blood pressure, and pulse rate. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the evolutionary trajectory of vital sign monitoring systems tailored explicitly for military personnel, harnessing the potential of wearable antenna technology. The scope of wearable antenna technology is expansive, spanning microstrip antennas, printed dipole antennas, slot antennas, monopole antennas, printed loop antennas, and planar inverted F antennas (PIFA). This research introduces an innovative paradigm in military healthcare by pioneering the integration of a Patch microstrip Antenna and an advanced Vital Sign Monitoring System (VSMS). The Patch microstrip Antenna, meticulously engineered for military vital sign monitoring at 2.4 GHz, boasts impressive specifications, including a VSWR of 1.8182, Desired Impedance of 100 ohms, and Characteristic Impedance of 55 ohms. Constructed with a Polystyrene substrate and copper material, it features dimensions of 0.035156m in length and 0.031641m in width. Simultaneously, the VSMS seamlessly incorporates state-of-the-art wearable antennas into soldiers' uniforms, enabling real-time and non-intrusive monitoring. The collected data is wirelessly transmitted for real-time processing and analysis in a central monitoring unit, with the entire project implemented using MATLAB software for design purposes. Key features of this integrated system include adaptability to diverse environments, interference robustness, and low power consumption. Wearable antennas exhibit resilience to military rigors, ensuring reliability in the most demanding conditions. Real-time monitoring empowers timely responses to health emergencies, while intelligent algorithms enable anomaly detection for proactive healthcare.

articleTitle: Beyond the Password: A Data-Driven Analysis of Biometric Security in the Age of AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This research presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of Biometric research in the cybersecurity domain from 2017 to 2024, utilizing the Scopus database. The study explores 40 publications to discern trends, influential authors, affiliated institutions, countries of origin, and subject areas. Employing bibliometric methods, the analysis includes publication count, co-authorship, keyword co-occurrence, and citation analyses. Results illustrate a rise in publications until 2019, followed by a subsequent decline. Notable authors like Gavrilova, M. and collaborative networks were identified. The research predominantly originates from institutions in the United States, Canada, India, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Pakistan. Computer Science emerges as the primary subject area, indicating a predominant interest among researchers. A word cloud depicts prominent terms associated with cybersecurity and biometrics, highlighting key focus areas in the field.

articleTitle: Pioneering Excellence in Semiconductor Manufacturing via XGBoost with BAT Optimization for Cutting-Edge Predictive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This study aims to revolutionize predictive maintenance in semiconductor manufacturing by using the SECOM dataset. The main objective is to create a precise and flexible predictive model by combining the XGBoost algorithm with BAT optimization techniques. The methodology involves intricate data preprocessing, incorporating data cleaning, handling multicollinearity, and using SMOTE-EEN to address the imbalanced SECOM dataset. The model is built using the robust XGBoost algorithm, and hyperparameter tuning is performed using BAT optimization techniques. The research results show great potential, with the model achieving a high accuracy of 0.99 and a strong F1 score of 0.95. The results confirm the model's effectiveness in predicting equipment failures in semiconductor manufacturing processes. The combination of XGBoost and BAT optimization techniques highlights the robustness and flexibility in dealing with the complex nature of the SECOM dataset. This study represents a significant advancement in predictive maintenance for semiconductor manufacturing. The integrated model provides a cutting-edge fault prediction solution, minimizing downtime and improving production efficiency.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of a Conversational AI-Driven Healthcare Bot with Pose Estimation for Precision Fitness Monitoring and Personalized Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This research investigates a new healthcare paradigm through the analysis of a conversational AI-powered healthcare bot that has posture estimation capabilities for accurate fitness tracking and customized recommendations. User motions during workout routines are accurately and thoroughly assessed thanks to the incorporation of powerful posture estimation technology. With the help of individualized exercise advice, this thorough study explores the capabilities of the system and shows how it may transform wellness practices. The healthcare bot provides an innovative method of fitness tracking by using conversational AI and accurate posture prediction to customize recommendations based on user requirements. This novel combination promises to enhance wellbeing and provide consumers with a more efficient and customized workout experience. The study emphasizes this point.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Routing Protocols in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks for Highway Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This study assesses the efficacy of three routing protocols, namely Ad-hoc on-Demand Distance Vector (AODV), Dynamic Source Routing (DSR), and Direct Sequence Distance Vector (DSDV), in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) utilizing the Network Simulator-2 (NS-2). The research evaluates the impact of different speeds and node densities on network efficiency in highway settings that simulate real-world scenarios. This assessment focuses on throughput, packet delivery ratio (PDR), end-to-end delay, and normalized routing overhead. The simulation findings demonstrate that DSR outperforms in terms of PDR, throughput, and routing overhead as the node density increases. On the other hand, DSDV performs exceptionally well in offering greater packet delivery ratios and throughput, with reduced delays, as mobility increases. These findings emphasize the need to select the appropriate routing protocol for VANETs, considering specific deployment factors such as node density and mobility. The study not only enhances comprehension of the strengths and weaknesses of AODV, DSR, and DSDV in VANETs but also guides network designers and researchers to optimize protocol performance for enhanced network stability and efficiency. Potential areas for future research include investigating the implementation of hybrid protocols to optimize the performance of VANETs.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms in Times Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This paper presents a thorough exploration of time series analysis within the broader landscape of machine learning and deep learning. From fundamental principles such as linear modeling to more complex neural network structures, the paper navigates the evolving terrain of predictive modeling. It discusses the amalgamation of various methodologies within machine learning and deep learning, addressing challenges related to interpretability, ethical considerations, and biases inherent in training datasets. Emerging trends, including the wider accessibility of methodologies through open-source tools and a growing emphasis on transparency, are brought to light. Looking ahead, the paper envisions ongoing innovation in time series analysis, incorporating diverse approaches such as reinforcement learning, federated learning, and domain-specific knowledge. It underscores the need to address ethical concerns and biases for a future where predictive analytics is not only accurate but also ethically grounded and universally applicable.

articleTitle: AirWave: Enhancing UAV Connectivity in Cellular Networks through an Integrated Simulation Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This study presents AirWave, an innovative modeling framework tailored to address the challenges associated with integrating Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) into 5G and future cellular networks. With the rising prominence of UAVs across various industries, ensuring uninterrupted connectivity and efficient mobility management within cellular networks becomes paramount. AirWave offers a comprehensive simulation environment, amalgamating network and physics simulations using ns-3 for network simulation, Gazebo for physics simulation, and integrating PX4 autopilot for realistic UAV flight dynamics. This framework facilitates in-depth investigations into UAV mobility and handover management, including a trajectory optimization technique based on reinforcement learning for cellular-connected drones. Extensive simulations demonstrate the versatility and effectiveness of AirWave, showcasing notable improvements in UAV range, connectivity, and management within cellular networks. These findings hold significant promise for advancing research and practical applications in UAV communications.

articleTitle: Blockchain Cloud Computing: Comparative study on DDoS, MITM and SQL Injection Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This research paper explores the potential of using blockchain technology in cloud computing security to mitigate DDoS, MITM, and SQL injection attacks. The paper discusses the traditional security measures used in cloud computing and how attackers can bypass these measures at each layer of the OSI model. The proposed solution suggests utilizing blockchain features at each layer of the OSI model to enhance cloud security measures. The paper provides a detailed explanation of how the proposed blockchain-based security measures can be used to prevent DDoS, MITM, and SQL injection attacks. It is crucial to remember that the suggested remedy has not been put to the test in real life, and more investigation and testing are required to confirm its viability and efficacy. Overall, the integration of blockchain technology into cloud computing security shows promising potential to enhance the security of cloud environments.

articleTitle: A Review on Blood Disease Detection using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Patient’s data is gathered during medical procedures in order to assist the doctor in making an accurate diagnosis of the patient's health. This information may consist of straightforward symptoms that the subject has noticed, a doctor's preliminary findings, or a thorough test result from a laboratory. Therefore, a doctor is the only one who uses this data for examination, the doctor then determines the ailment using his or her own medical skills. Assessing if a patient has heart illness, diabetes, cancer or any other blood related disease the artificial intelligence has classified numerous disease datasets using various classification algorithms like Machine learning, Deep learning, Data Mining, Automation and so on. The field of computer science known as artificial intelligence focuses on the intelligence of machine and generates the highest possibilities for achievement and accuracy. The primary goal of this article is a survey of AI methods used in medical research to identify blood disease or disorders and find out which artificial intelligence technique is best suited for highest accuracy in blood disease or disorders diagnostics.

articleTitle: Optimizing Quality of Service in Fog Computing using Blockchain Integration: Exploring Approaches, Challenges, and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: In today’s computing era, fog computing has emerged as a transformative paradigm, facilitating real-time data processing at the network edge to reduce latency and enhance responsiveness. However, ensuring optimal Quality of Service (QoS) in fog environments, while safeguarding data integrity, presents a tough challenge. This research endeavours to address this critical concern by introducing a comprehensive framework that systematically boosts QoS through the meticulous integration of blockchain technology. Probing into the association of fog computing and blockchain, this study pioneers sophisticated strategies that target the reduction of latency, the amplification of scalability, and the precision management of resources. Through complex process of implementation and systematic evaluation, our proposed strategies manifest demonstrable enhancements across key QoS metrics, prominently including latency and throughput. These enhancements are substantiated through the inclusion of practical case studies that highlight the tangible benefits of our approach in a diverse range of scenarios. This research advances the understanding of the synergistic potential of fog computing and blockchain, while simultaneously empowering practitioners with actionable insights to bind these technologies harmoniously. By combining these innovations, both enhanced QoS and fortified data processing at the network edge become attainable objectives, furthering the evolution of modern computing paradigms.

articleTitle: A Robust Development of an Efficient Industrial Monitoring and Fault Identification Model using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly developing technologies and the Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of physical items or effects embedded with computer software, detectors, and network connectivity. The Internet of Things also addresses the issue of centralizing physical bias management online. We are leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) idea to construct a system that will automatically monitor all artificial processes and issue warnings or expert comments when necessary. nowadays, gas leakage is a serious concern in the house and as well as vigilance. If the gas sense is indeed low, it's because we've been too careless, intolerant, or both to look for it. If the gas position is raised, however, calamity may ensue. In this research, the crucial concept is introduced to prevent this catastrophe from occurring. In this study, we propose an alternate approach to this impending calamity and design a system with integrated sensors, controllers, and some IoT-assisted software. The suggested method, known as the Internet of Things based Industrial Safety System (IoTISS), is compared against the more established Industrial Safety System (ISS) to see how well it performs. In this system, we are monitoring the detection of gas leakages with various warning characteristics as well as other devices are used for monitoring various aspects like humidity and temperature using DHT22 sensor, MQ2 gas monitoring sensor, fire sensor and NodeMCU ESP8266 WiFi module. NodeMCU ESP8266, which doubles as a WiFi module, will receive data from all of these types of sensors.

articleTitle: ECOGUARD: Forest Fire Detection System using Deep Learning Improved with Elastic Weight Consolidation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Forest fires are a serious hazard to both human safety and the environment, necessitating the development of effective detection systems. This research proposes an AI-based forest fire detection system that leverages computer vision and deep learning techniques. The system processes real-time images from cameras installed in forested areas to identify signs of fire or smoke, aiding in forest conservation efforts. By employing pre-trained CNN models, namely ResNet and DenseNet, and incorporating Elastic Weight Consolidation, the system achieves high accuracy while preserving knowledge from prior tasks. The system's ability to learn continuously allows it to adjust and perform better over time without losing important data. The proposed forest fire detection system offers real-time fire detection capabilities, facilitating timely intervention and efficient management of forest fires. Additionally, it boasts cost-effectiveness and multilingual support, making it practical and applicable in diverse forested regions. Overall, this research presents a significant advancement in forest fire detection technology, promising substantial contributions to environmental preservation and community safety. The fusion of AI, computer vision, and continual learning through Elastic Weight Consolidation holds great potential for revolutionizing forest fire management and safeguarding our natural ecosystems.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture Using Web-GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The prevalence of geographic data in web GIS systems has made it necessary to develop effective and intuitive techniques for finding and exploring pertinent information. This paper describes the creation and assessment of precision agriculture system. Farmers now manage their land and crops in a completely different way because of precision agriculture, or the integration of modern technologies into agricultural practises. Precision agriculture benefits greatly from WebGIS, or web-based geographic information system, which gives farmers a centralised platform to view, analyse, and visualise geographic data. Significant insights into soil conditions, crop health, and environmental factors may be gained from this data, which was collected via sensors, satellites, and drones. With the use of WebGIS, farmers may make better informed decisions on yield optimisation, irrigation, pest control, and resource allocation.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Design Secured and Privacy Enabled Health Data Linkage System based on Cyber Security Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Medical records from a variety of sources must be integrated into healthcare data repositories for knowledge discovery to be possible. An essential area of study is how to keep records linked when merging medical data. Researchers have proposed many solutions to this issue, all of which are relevant to industrialized nations that use patient identification numbers such as social security numbers, health insurance numbers, universal patient identifiers (UPIs), etc., to keep track of electronic health records. Because of issues with missing data, unclear patient identification, and excessive noise in patient information, these systems are not suitable for record linking of health data in underdeveloped nations. There is a serious concern that patients' personally identifiable information stored in electronic health records poses a threat to their privacy and leaves health information systems open to intrusion. We have examined the real-world challenges of healthcare data collection and integration for a national health data warehouse in this article. To accommodate the limited health data of poor nations like Bangladesh, we have developed privacy-preserving secured record linkage architecture we call Secured Health Data Handler (SHDH). For the purpose of facilitating the knowledge discovery process, our approach may anonymize identifying private data of patients while preserving record linkage in integrated health repositories. Even without a standard ID, our suggested strategy was able to connect records with sufficient accuracy for noisy data, according to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Communication: Integrated Satellite Aerial for 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: The literature on point-to-point (P2P) connections in integrated satellite-aerial networks—which are acknowledged as essential elements in the implementation of sixth-generation (6G) wirelessly networks—is examined in this investigation. The first section describes the features that set apart these large and complex networks, which are often called spatial networks. It focuses on two main types of spatial infrastructures: satellite constellations and high-altitude sites (HAPs). The following hierarchy classifies P2P connections, which include HAP-to-HAP links (HHL), satellite-to-satellite links across various levels (SSLD), and satellite-to-satellite links inside the same layer (SSLL). A detailed analysis of all the layers in spatial networks is then provided, with a focus on the possible properties of connecting links (e.g., radio-frequency or free-space optics) and a comprehensive review of the link-budget results that have been published so far. The discussion then emphasizes the possible advantages of setting up a cohesive satellite-HAP network, especially when it comes to providing broadband services to distant and underserved locations. Finally, future directions in the field of spatial networks are highlighted, such as intelligent transfer, smart platforms, energy conservation in distributed spatial networks, routing, large-scale network optimization, and numerous access strategies.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Carbon Emission using the IoT Mechanism in the Cold Storage System of the Commercial Units in the Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: Cold storage facilities are vital to the world’s food supply chain and are crucial for the preservation of perishable goods. But these establishments use a lot of energy, mostly to regulate the temperature, which results in a lot of carbon emissions. Using Internet of Things (IoT) mechanisms to track and evaluate carbon emissions in cold storage systems is the focus of this research, which aims to increase environmental sustainability and energy efficiency. We gather real-time data on temperature, energy consumption, and other pertinent parameters in the cold storage environment using Internet of Things (IoT) sensors and devices. We examine the connection between operational parameters and carbon emissions by combining this data with energy consumption and emissions data. Variables including storage capacity, insulation, refrigeration equipment, and usage patterns are taken into account in our analysis. We find trends, patterns, and possible areas for optimization by putting machine learning models and advanced analytics into practice. Operators of cold storage facilities can make better decisions to lower carbon emissions and boost overall efficiency by using the insights gathered from this analysis. The study also emphasizes how predictive maintenance and smart control systems can improve cold storage operations’ cost-effectiveness and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Enhanced CNN-Based Decision Support Framework for Gastrointestinal Neuroendocrine Tumors using Inception-Resnet-V2
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Big Data & Machine Learning (ICBDML)
abstract: This research addresses the challenge of providing accurate decision support for Gastrointestinal Neuroendocrine Tumors (GI NETs) by introducing a novel Inception-ResNet-v2 enhanced CNN-based framework. There are currently no all-inclusive systems that successfully combine genetic, imaging, and clinical data. The Inception-ResNet-v2 model, which is well-known for its feature extraction capabilities, is used in our proposed system to bridge this gap by integrating various modalities into a single architecture. Due to GI NETs' intrinsic complexity, a nuanced approach is required, and our solution outperforms the current techniques. In terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, our model routinely surpasses previous studies in comparison evaluations. The model outperforms previous research with impressive results: 92% accuracy, 94% precision, 91% recall, and 92% F1 score. The confusion matrix shows that the model can produce more accurate classifications, with less false positives and negatives. Not only does this study present a state-of-the-art decision support framework, but it also proven its worth by comparing it to existing standards in great detail. This model has the potential to be a game-changer in the field of precision medicine, according to the outcomes that have been shown. It will help us better understand and treat gastrointestinal NETs, which is a complex condition.
